How to get it :
- Crafting table (x6) : [[gv:billet_uranium_fuel|Uranium Fuel Billet]].
- [[Gas Centrifuge|Gas Centrifuge]] (x6) : 1200 mB Uranium Hexafluoride.
- Crafting table (x9) : [[gv:ingot_uranium_fuel|Ingot of Uranium Fuel]].

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_mox_fuel|MOX Fuel Billet]], [[gv:billet_uranium_fuel|Uranium Fuel Billet]], [[gv:ingot_uranium_fuel|Ingot of Uranium Fuel]], [[gv:pwr_fuel_bfb_pu241|Plutonium-241 PWR BFB Rod]].
